奥地利的高资质人才通道：按 100 分制打分，满 70 分即可。没有工作邀请也能: Austria's route for very highly qualified workers: a 100-point scale, 70 points to qualify. You can enter first on a six-month job-seeker visa with no job offer, then switch to a 24-month Red-White-Red Card once you find a matching position; after 21 months of qualifying employment you can move to the unrestricted Red-White-Red Card plus. Nationality is not a barrier for mainland Chinese passports, the real gate is points: whether your degree counts as a MINT subject, and whether you are under 35.
法规未按国籍设限，中国大陆护照持有人可申。两条硬门槛：①高等教育学历的课程时长不: The regulations set no nationality restriction, so mainland Chinese passport holders can apply. Two hard gates: (1) the higher-education programme must be at least four years long (three-year degrees go through the shortage-occupation or other-key-worker routes, which require 55 points); (2) you must reach 70 of 100 points.
不设年龄上下限，只影响积分：申请时未满 35 岁得 20 分，未满 40 岁得: No upper or lower age limit; age only affects points. Under 35 at application: 20 points. Under 40: 15. Under 45: 10. At 45 or older this item scores zero, but you can still apply if the other items add up to 70. A range of 0-99 means no age threshold, not unverified.
须完成不少于四年的高等教育课程（学士通常按四年制计；三年制本科不满足本通道的学历: You need a higher-education programme of at least four years (a bachelor is normally counted as four years; a three-year bachelor does not meet the duration requirement for this route). The subject drives the score: mathematics, informatics, natural sciences and technology (MINT) score 30, other subjects 20; a PhD or habilitation scores 40. Only regulated professions (health care, public-school teachers, lawyers and similar) need formal recognition; everything else is assessed from the documents submitted, with no equivalence procedure.
德语或英语达到 CEFR A1 得 5 分，A2 得 10 分（本项上限 10: German or English at CEFR A1 scores 5, A2 scores 10 (this item caps at 10). French, Spanish or Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian at B1 score 5 each. Language certificates must be no more than five years old. Recognised German providers are OESD, Goethe-Institut, Telc and the Austrian Integration Fund (OeIF); recognised English certificates are Cambridge, TELC, IELTS, TOEIC and TOEFL. The official page sets no minimum level: A1 scores, so language affects points but not eligibility.
申请找工作签证时须提供「足够生计来源」证明（工资单、雇佣合同、养老金凭证、投资或: A job-seeker visa application needs proof of adequate means of subsistence (payslips, employment contract, pension or insurance benefits, investment capital or sufficient own assets); no fixed amount is published. If you apply for the Red-White-Red Card directly with a job offer, the general settlement requirements on accommodation and income are waived, because a matching position and the statutory minimum salary are already in place.
须持覆盖全部风险的医疗保险（法定保险或等效保单），且在递交申请时即须提供。旅行医: Health insurance covering all risks (statutory or an equivalent policy) is required at the time of application. Travel health insurance is accepted if it covers costs well above EUR 30,000 and includes a guarantee for rescue and return costs.
许多受理机关要求提交国籍国（或此前连续居住超过 6 个月的国家）的无犯罪记录证明: Many authorities ask for a criminal record extract from your country of nationality, or from any country where you lived for more than six months, issued no more than three months before submission. Whether it is mandatory depends on the authority handling your case.
与 health_check 同一份保单；入境并受雇后转入奥地利法定社会保险。: The same policy as the health check; once you enter and take up employment you move into Austrian statutory social insurance.
红白红卡部分类别受年度配额限制，官方页面在受理机关说明中提到「受配额约束的申请」: Some Red-White-Red Card categories are subject to annual quotas; the official pages refer to quota-bound applications. No separate published figure exists for this route, so confirm the current year's availability with the authority before filing.
全年可申请，无固定开放窗口。配额与短缺职业清单按年度更新（短缺职业清单 2026: Applications are accepted year round with no fixed window. Quotas and the shortage-occupation list are updated annually (the 2026 list is published), so re-check before filing.
现行规则：高资质人才积分门槛 70 分（满分 100）；红白红卡一般签发 24: Rules as of verification: 70 of 100 points for very highly qualified workers; the Red-White-Red Card is generally issued for 24 months.
官方页面列明的 Jobseeker Visa 费用。仅在没有工作邀请、先入境找工: Job-seeker visa fee as listed on the official page. Only needed on the route where you enter first and look for work without an offer.
官方页面列明的 Application fee。两条路径（直接申请红白红卡、或持: Application fee as listed on the official page. Payable on both routes, whether you apply directly for the card or enter on a job-seeker visa first.
官方未公布统一审理时限。流程是：受理机关（使领馆或境内居留管理局）收件后转联邦劳: No unified processing time is published. The authority (embassy, consulate or the residence office inside Austria) forwards the file to the Public Employment Service (AMS), which checks points, qualification and the salary offered; the residence authority then issues the card. Actual duration depends on embassy appointment availability and AMS review, is measured in months in practice, and the official sources publish no quotable number of days.
尺寸 45×35 mm，拍摄时间不超过 6 个月: 45 x 35 mm, taken within the last six months
须能证明课程时长不少于四年；MINT 学科须另附能证明专业的材料。非德语/英语材: Must show the programme lasted at least four years; MINT subjects need additional proof of the field. Documents not in German or English need a German or English translation
德语 A1/A2 或英语 A1/A2（按 CEFR），证书不得早于申请前 5 年: German A1/A2 or English A1/A2 under the CEFR; the certificate must be no more than five years old
推荐信与在职/离职证明，按每满半年计 1 分；在奥地利的工作经历每半年计 2 分: References and employment certificates; each full half-year scores 1 point, and each half-year worked in Austria scores 2
覆盖全部风险；旅行险保额须远高于 3 万欧元并含救援与送返担保: Covers all risks; travel insurance must be well above EUR 30,000 and include rescue and return cover
仅申请找工作签证时需要；凭工作邀请直接申请红白红卡时该要求被豁免: Only needed for the job-seeker visa; waived when you apply for the card directly with a job offer
租房合同、租赁意向书或产权证明。直接申请红白红卡时与收入一并豁免: Tenancy agreement, letter of intent to lease or proof of ownership. Waived together with the income requirement when you apply for the card directly
有工作邀请时必需，写明未来岗位与薪资；由雇主出具: Required when you have a job offer; states the future position and salary, issued by the employer
随找工作签证申请表一并提交，官方提供英文表格: Submitted together with the job-seeker visa application; the official English form is provided
先自算积分，确认够 70 分: Score yourself first and confirm you reach 70
特殊资格与技能上限 40 分（四年制高等教育毕业 20、MINT 学科 30、博: Special qualifications and skills cap at 40: a four-year higher-education degree 20, a MINT subject 30, a PhD or habilitation 40; a previous year's gross salary of EUR 50,000-60,000 as a senior manager at a listed company or one vouched for by the Austrian trade office scores 20, EUR 60,000-70,000 scores 25, above EUR 70,000 scores 30; research and innovation activity 20; recognised awards 20. Work experience caps at 20 (1 point per full half-year, 2 per half-year in Austria). Language caps at 10, age at 20, studies in Austria at 10. Total 100, threshold 70.
算一遍官方给的示例，确认自己的算法没错: Run the official worked example to check your own arithmetic
官方示例：30 岁俄罗斯信息学毕业生，6 年以上工作经验，英语良好——MINT: The official example: a 30-year-old Russian informatics graduate with over six years of experience and good English. MINT subject 30 + six years of work 12 + English A2 10 + under 35 20 = 72 points, past the 70 threshold. Note that experience counts 1 point per full half-year, so six years is twelve half-years.
决定走哪条路径：先入境找工作，还是先拿工作邀请: Choose your route: enter first and search, or secure an offer first
没有工作邀请：申请 6 个月的找工作签证（D 类），本人到奥地利驻华使领馆递交。: No job offer: apply for the six-month job-seeker visa (Category D) in person at the Austrian embassy or consulate. Job offer in hand: apply in person at the embassy, or let the prospective employer file with the residence authority inside Austria. Both routes need 70 points.
备齐材料并等待 AMS 审核: Assemble the file and wait for the AMS review
受理机关收件后转联邦劳动局（AMS），由 AMS 核对积分、学历与拟付薪资是否达: The authority forwards the file to the Public Employment Service (AMS), which verifies your points, your qualification and whether the salary offered meets the collective agreement or statutory minimum. Once AMS gives a positive opinion, the residence authority issues the card provided the general settlement requirements are met (accommodation and income excepted).
持卡满 21 个月后换红白红卡 plus: After 21 months, move to the Red-White-Red Card plus
红白红卡一般签发 24 个月，与申请时指定的雇主绑定。在过去 24 个月中按资格: The card is generally issued for 24 months and tied to the employer named in the application. After 21 months of qualifying employment within the preceding 24, as assessed by AMS, you can apply for the Red-White-Red Card plus, which gives unrestricted labour-market access so a change of employer no longer needs a new application.
红白红卡一般签发 24 个月，与申请中指定的雇主绑定。换雇主须重新申请一份带劳动: The card is generally issued for 24 months and tied to the employer named in the application. Changing employer means filing for a new residence permit with labour-market access; you may start the new job once 45 days have passed from filing, provided the documents needed for the review were submitted in full, otherwise the 45 days are suspended until they are. After 21 months of qualifying employment within the preceding 24, as assessed by AMS, you can apply for the Red-White-Red Card plus, which brings unrestricted employment and settlement.
持红白红卡只能为申请中指定的雇主工作，可兼营自雇但须从属于受雇关系。找工作签证期: The card lets you work only for the employer named in the application; self-employment is allowed when it is subsidiary to that employment. The job-seeker visa does not permit work at all: it is a Category D visa granting six months to search, and you can start working only once you find a matching position and file for the card. Regulated professions (health care, public-school teachers, early-childhood educators, lawyers) require formal recognition first.
70 分门槛实际上由学历分值主导。非 MINT 本科只有 20 分，须靠年龄 2: The 70-point gate is effectively decided by the degree. A non-MINT bachelor scores 20, so you need the full 20 for age, 10 for language and 20 for experience just to scrape through; a MINT bachelor at 30 leaves real headroom. If the subject does not fit, this route is effectively closed.
找工作签证只有 6 个月，且到期未拿到红白红卡时处境被动：若已在奥地利境内当面递: The job-seeker visa lasts six months and leaves you exposed if the card has not come through: if you filed the card application in person inside Austria you may wait there for the outcome, otherwise you must leave and wait abroad.
红白红卡与雇主绑定，两年内换工作要重新申请居留许可，并等 45 天才能上岗。把这: The card is tied to one employer, so changing jobs within the first two years means a new residence application plus a 45-day wait before you can start. Budget for that gap if you plan to use the card as a stepping stone.
部分类别受年度配额约束，官方未公开本通道的具体名额数字。配额用尽时即使分数够也无: Some categories are subject to annual quotas and no figure is published for this route. If the quota is exhausted you cannot be approved that year even with enough points, so confirm with the authority before filing.
学费与生活成本：找工作签证期间不能工作，6 个月的开销须自行承担；奥地利官方未规: Cost of living: you cannot work while on the job-seeker visa, so six months of expenses are on you, and Austria publishes no minimum funds figure for that period, leaving it to the authority's case-by-case judgement.
优势：不需要先有工作邀请即可入境；35 岁以下直接 20 分；MINT 学科 3: Upside: you can enter without a job offer first; being under 35 is worth 20 points; a MINT subject is worth 30; English at A1/A2 also scores, so German is not a hard gate. Compared with the German Opportunity Card the points bar is higher (70 of 100 versus a 6-point scale), but what you get is a 24-month work residence permit with full employment rights, not a 20-hour-a-week job-search permit.
